llm.summary: This is a local-only note and document organizer, but its delete and purge controls do not fully remove some stored file and image data from browser storage.

dimensions.detail: Browser clipboard, file picker, localStorage, IndexedDB, and download APIs are proportionate for a local note/file manager and docx exporter; no network transmission was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a non-executable skill description plus a static HTML file and reference markdown; no package install, backend, or hidden setup script is present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger wording is broad, but the examples still mostly match text collection, clipboard organization, local archiving, and skill packaging use cases.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The app stores user text, images, and uploaded files locally, but several deletion paths remove only metadata and can leave original blobs orphaned in IndexedDB, despite user-facing claims of permanent deletion.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is coherent: it provides a single-file HTML app for collecting text, managing pasted images/files, saving locally, and exporting Word documents.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a browser-local notebook that keeps pasted text, images, and uploaded files in localStorage/IndexedDB. Do not rely on the app's delete or purge buttons to fully erase sensitive uploaded files or images; clear the site's browser storage when true removal is needed.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad Chinese trigger examples could cause over-invocation, but they are not evidence of hidden or unrelated behavior because the artifact implements the described local text/image/file organizer.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only description and interface may be inconvenient in mixed-language environments, but this is a transparency/usability note rather than a security-policy concern.
